description: Customer asks where their order is (happy path)
message: Where is my order SE10234? It was supposed to arrive yesterday.

description: Customer wants to return shoes (policy + workflow)
message: I want to return the running shoes I bought last week. They don't fit properly.
expected_outcome: Check policy, initiate return, provide pickup date

message: I'm looking for a laptop for college. Can you compare the HP Pavilion and Lenovo IdeaPad? Which one is better for programming and everyday use?

description: VIP customer reports damaged expensive phone (escalation path)
message: I received my Samsung Galaxy S24 with a cracked screen! This is a Rs 75000 phone and it arrived broken. I'm extremely frustrated and want this resolved immediately!
expected_outcome: Escalate to replacement team due to high value + angry sentiment

message: I tried to apply coupon code SAVE20 on my cart but it says 'coupon not applicable'. My cart total is Rs 3500 and I'm buying a laptop sleeve. Why isn't it working?

message: I returned my shoes 5 days ago and still haven't received my refund. When will I get my money back?
